decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system builds directly on the firm's established desk and furniture expertise, so absorptive capacity supports interpreting feedback and improving the line.
The chair family is close to the existing range, enabling the firm to assimilate results and refine the product with related knowledge.
Floor cushions from carpets extend the firm's material and upholstery knowledge, allowing the firm to learn from early results and improve the line.
The soft upholstered sofa remains close to the firm's upholstery competence, so related knowledge supports continued improvement despite its weaker initial presentation.
The high standing table draws on existing table solutions, giving the firm the absorptive capacity to recognise and act on learning.
